runtime: Python 3.13/3.14 domain/service layer over LLD-01 SQLite STRICT persistence and UnitOfWork abstractions
Python standard-library datetime/zoneinfo for schedule conversion; LLD-12 packaging must guarantee an offline IANA tzdata source on supported Windows installations
hashlib.sha256 over canonical bounded proposal/input serialization for stale/rejection fingerprints

algorithm_choices.overlap_components: sort eligible interval tuples by (start_utc,end_utc,task_id), then perform one sweep maintaining component max_end; a new interval joins iff start_utc < current_component_max_end; start_utc == max_end starts a new strict-overlap component
algorithm_choices.complexity: O(n log n) time from sorting and O(n) compact tuple/work-index memory; pairwise O(n^2) overlap enumeration is forbidden
algorithm_choices.proposal_diff: persist only affected Task/Objectives and exact expected revisions/plan revisions/membership revisions; large previews page over persisted rows
algorithm_choices.ordinal: derive month bucket and 1-based ordinal from effective actual start when known otherwise current reviewed Objective envelope start, in current Objective timezone; tie by immutable objective_id; never persist current ordinal as identity

projection_strategy: objective_envelope_projection and objective_aggregate_projection are rebuildable but transactionally maintained in the same UoW as Task plan-pin/membership/execution/outcome changes
Objective envelope derives from current membership rows' pinned accepted plan_revision_id, not from an unreviewed newer Task current-plan pointer
Task execution/outcome current rows are rebuildable projections over append-only evidence/review events

startup/spec validation must verify required indexes, FK coverage, projection revision consistency and no current Objective strict-overlap violation before accepting writes; drift fails closed into diagnostics/recovery rather than silently repairing operational history
concurrency: all expensive global grouping and preview work uses an LLD-01 snapshot outside writer lock

acceptance opens one short BEGIN IMMEDIATE UoW, revalidates exact affected revisions/locks and indexed envelope overlaps, inserts the command receipt, applies row-wise changes/projections/audit, then commits
single-process writer serialization plus commit-time overlap query prevents concurrent accepted overlapping Objectives
background grouping jobs never mutate Task plans or Objective memberships without the normal reviewed acceptance command
security: all identifiers/state enums dispatch through closed code registries/static SQL
timezone name is validated via ZoneInfo lookup and never used as a filesystem path
reason strings and proposal summaries obey bounds.json and named audit payload schemas
client-supplied calculated envelopes, aggregate states, overlap claims, reviewed_at, actor IDs or lock booleans are never trusted authority
